record.name: Pakistan
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The 2025 National AI Policy establishes an AI Council and plans centres of excellence and sandboxes, but no model-evaluation body.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

Re-ran searches in English and Urdu for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described the 2025 National AI Policy, an AI Council and Indus AI Week. Reviewed the government summit release as primary governance evidence. Raised confidence to medium under the status-confidence rule: recorded queries in English and a national or official language, and cited primary governance evidence consistent with no qualifying institute. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: PK-search = searches 1, 2 (en, ur). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English and Urdu; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The government's February 2026 account of the Indus AI Summit describes the Islamabad Declaration, whose principles are meant to guide AI implementation across all tiers of government. It names no body to evaluate advanced models. The 2025 National AI Policy itself could not be retrieved from the ministry site (HTTP 404).

related_bodies.name: AI Council
related_bodies.role: It oversees the National AI Policy 2025 as a ministerial council.

record.notes: A government account of the February 2026 Indus AI Summit describes sovereign compute, research investment and national governance initiatives. The government headline reports that the Indus AI Summit 2026 concluded in Islamabad. Searches covered indexed public English and Urdu sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.

sources.title: The Global Landscape of AI Safety Institutes

excerpts.text: Indus AI Summit 2026 Concludes in Islamabad with Landmark Policy Frameworks and Global Partnerships

Rather than serving as a purely aspirational policy, the Islamabad Declaration is designed to guide practical implementation across all tiers of government and the broader economy, ensuring that Pakistan's AI development remains ethical, secure, and aligned with sovereign interests.
